title: urlSync pushes new history state on load if searchFunction is used
body:
**Do you want to request a *feature* or report a *bug*?**
Bug

Code is here, urlSync seems not to work with jsfiddle:
https://jsfiddle.net/9n8Lnqas/

**Bug: What is the current behavior?**
When instant search is created and the query is modified by searchFunction, urlSync pushes a new state to history on load. This behavior was implemented in v2.2.2 with a fix for #2530 

**Bug: What is the expected behavior?**
Previous to version 2.2.2, urlSync only pushes new states after user interaction with instantsearch. If new states are being created in browser history on load, this poses a problem for sites with catalog views that utilize instantsearch. In our case, thousands of pages are immediately appended with instantsearch parameters after page/instantsearch loading. We use searchFunction for various facets that are subject to change based other previous user interactions on the site.

**Bug: What browsers are impacted? Which versions?**
All browsers that support the history API when urlSync option is used.

**Bug: What is the proposed solution?**
There may be a better way to resolve issue #2530 , or maybe additional urlSync options could make this configurable.

**What is the version you are using? Always use the latest one before opening a bug issue.**
v2.2.2 Currently using 2.2.1 to get around this.
